resources.string: Paste your key and choose STT, translation and TTS on your phone. Approve the result here.
Connect the TV to a private Wi-Fi or Ethernet network before opening phone setup. No private local address was found.
Scan this QR code with your phone camera to open this temporary TV setup session.

1. Connect your phone to the same home network.
2. Scan the QR code with your phone camera.
3. Match the pairing code and paste your OpenAI key.
4. Send the setup, then approve it on this TV.
Use a private home network. Guest Wi-Fi, VPNs and router device isolation can block setup. For shared networks, use your TV’s paired phone keyboard.
This setup window lasts five minutes and closes when you leave. The QR code contains a temporary pairing token, never your API key.
Use the OpenAI key already saved on this TV
Setup saved. You can close the phone page and start captions.
This phone setup session has ended. Close this screen and open phone setup again for a new QR code.
Scan for Google TV phone remote instructions for iPhone and Android.

On supported Android and Google TVs, the Google TV app on iPhone or Android can enter text on the TV.

Open the phone app, select this TV, and pair using the code shown by the TV. Then open the API key field in Hearth and paste the key using the phone keyboard.

Both devices must be reachable on the same network. Your TV must support the Android TV Remote Service. This QR opens the official setup instructions, not a Hearth pairing session.
Enter or paste a key in the TV field
